about: Hand-written labelled pairs for the echo guard (docs/trust.md). `shown` is a note the session was shown; `written` is what the agent then saved. echo=true: the written note restates the shown one (no new evidence). echo=false: a similar but independent note (new facts on the same topic). Pairs come in topic groups of two (pair i is in group floor(i/2)); even groups tune, odd groups report.
